쿼리 작성: SELECT

쿼리 작성: WITH cust_geo_states AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id, i.geolocation_state
  FROM customers c
  JOIN geolocation i
    ON i.geolocation_zip_code_prefix = c.customer_zip_code_prefix
),
per_uid AS (
  SELECT customer_unique_id,
         COUNT(DISTINCT geolocation_state) AS state_cnt,
         MIN(geolocation_state) AS only_state
  FROM cust_geo_states
  GROUP BY customer_unique_id
),
denom AS (
  SELECT i.geolocation_state AS geo_state,
         COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS customers_including
  FROM customers c
  JOIN geolocation i
    ON i.geolocation_zip_code_prefix = c.customer_zip_code_prefix
  GROUP BY i.geolocation_state
),
numer AS (
  SELECT only_state AS geo_state,
         COUNT(*) AS customers_exclusive
  FROM per_uid
  WHERE state_cnt = 1
  GROUP BY only_state
)
SELECT d.geo_state,
       COALESCE(n.customers_exclusive, 0) AS customers_exclusive,
       d.customers_including,
       COALESCE(n.customers_exclusive, 0) * 1.0 / d.customers_including AS exclusive_ratio
FROM denom d
LEFT JOIN numer n
  ON n.geo_state = d.geo_state
ORDER BY exclusive_ratio DESC, d.geo_state;

쿼리 작성: WITH uid_geo AS (

uid_cust AS (

SELECT g.customer_unique_id,

    g1.geolocation_city,
    g1.geolocation_state,
    g1.geolocation_zip_code_prefix AS zip1,
    g2.geolocation_zip_code_prefix AS zip2,
    6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(POWER(SIN(RADIANS(g2.geolocation_lat - g1.geolocation_lat) / 2), 2) +
                        COS(RADIANS(g1.geolocation_lat)) * COS(RADIANS(g2.geolocation_lat)) *
                        POWER(SIN(RADIANS(g2.geolocation_lng - g1.geolocation_lng) / 2), 2))) AS distance_km

  JOIN geolocation g2
    ON g1.geolocation_city = g2.geolocation_city
   AND g1.geolocation_state = g2.geolocation_state

쿼리 작성: WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    p.product_category_name AS category,
    oi.price
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  WHERE oi.shipping_limit_date >= '2017-04-01'
    AND oi.shipping_limit_date < '2017-07-01'
),
cat_avg AS (
  SELECT category, AVG(price) AS category_avg_price, COUNT(*) AS item_count
  FROM base
  GROUP BY category
),
flagged AS (
  SELECT b.category,
         CASE WHEN b.price > c.category_avg_price THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_above_avg
  FROM base b
  JOIN cat_avg c ON c.category = b.category
)
SELECT
  c.category,
  c.category_avg_price,
  SUM(f.is_above_avg) * 100.0 / c.item_count AS percent_above_avg
FROM cat_avg c
JOIN flagged f ON f.category = c.category
GROUP BY c.category, c.category_avg_price
ORDER BY percent_above_avg DESC;

  SELECT

    AND p.product_width_cm IS NOT NULL AND p.product_width_cm > 0
    AND p.product_height_cm IS NOT NULL AND p.product_height_cm > 0
  GROUP BY p.product_category_name, p.product_id, p.product_length_cm, p.product_width_cm, p.product_height_cm, p.product_photos_qty
) t
JOIN (
  SELECT
    p.product_category_name,
    MAX(p.product_length_cm * p.product_width_cm * p.product_height_cm) AS max_volume_cm3
  FROM order_items i
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
  WHERE i.shipping_limit_date >= '2018-01-01'
    AND i.shipping_limit_date < '2019-01-01'

    AND p.product_width_cm IS NOT NULL AND p.product_width_cm > 0
    AND p.product_height_cm IS NOT NULL AND p.product_height_cm > 0
  GROUP BY p.product_category_name
) m
  ON m.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
 AND m.max_volume_cm3 = t.volume_cm3
ORDER BY t.total_revenue DESC;

      PARTITION BY s.seller_state, YEAR(oi.shipping_limit_date)

    ) AS rn
  FROM order_items oi

  GROUP BY s.seller_state, YEAR(oi.shipping_limit_date), s.seller_city
)

WHERE rn <= 3

쿼리 작성: SELECT
  s.seller_city,
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.shipping_limit_date >= '2017-01-01' AND i.shipping_limit_date < '2018-01-01' THEN i.price ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2017,
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.shipping_limit_date >= '2018-01-01' AND i.shipping_limit_date < '2019-01-01' THEN i.price ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2018,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN i.shipping_limit_date >= '2017-01-01' AND i.shipping_limit_date < '2018-01-01' THEN i.price ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN (
      SUM(CASE WHEN i.shipping_limit_date >= '2018-01-01' AND i.shipping_limit_date < '2019-01-01' THEN i.price ELSE 0 END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN i.shipping_limit_date >= '2017-01-01' AND i.shipping_limit_date < '2018-01-01' THEN i.price ELSE 0 END)
    ) * 1.0
    / SUM(CASE WHEN i.shipping_limit_date >= '2017-01-01' AND i.shipping_limit_date < '2018-01-01' THEN i.price ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS growth_rate
FROM order_items i
JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = i.seller_id
GROUP BY s.seller_city
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN i.shipping_limit_date >= '2018-01-01' AND i.shipping_limit_date < '2019-01-01' THEN i.price ELSE 0 END) >= 5000
ORDER BY growth_rate DESC;

FROM (

  FROM order_items i
  JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = i.seller_id
  WHERE i.shipping_limit_date >= '2017-01-01'
    AND i.shipping_limit_date < '2018-01-01'
  GROUP BY s.seller_state, i.seller_id

GROUP BY t.seller_state
ORDER BY avg_revenue_per_seller DESC;

쿼리 작성: SELECT t.seller_id, t.product_id, t.avg_price
FROM (
  SELECT seller_id, product_id, AVG(price) AS avg_price
  FROM order_items
  GROUP BY seller_id, product_id
) t
JOIN (
  SELECT seller_id, MAX(avg_price) AS max_avg_price
  FROM (
    SELECT seller_id, product_id, AVG(price) AS avg_price
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY seller_id, product_id
  ) x
  GROUP BY seller_id
) m
ON t.seller_id = m.seller_id AND t.avg_price = m.max_avg_price

  GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(shipping_limit_date, '%Y-%m')
)
SELECT

  total_sales,
  total_sales - LAG(total_sales) OVER (ORDER BY ym) AS diff_from_prev_month
FROM monthly
ORDER BY ym;

DDL statements:

CREATE TABLE order_payments (order_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, payment_sequential INT NOT NULL, payment_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, payment_installments INT NOT NULL, payment_value DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (order_id, payment_sequential));

쿼리 작성: SELECT payment_type,

CREATE TABLE order_payments (order_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, payment_sequential INT NOT NULL, payment_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, payment_installments INT NOT NULL, payment_value DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (order_id, payment_sequential));

instruction:
입력 텍스트: 결제 수단별로, 그 수단이 사용된 주문 중 해당 수단만으로 결제된 주문의 비중을 계산해 주시고, 비중이 큰 순으로 정렬해 주실 수 있습니까?

DDL statements:

CREATE TABLE order_payments (order_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, payment_sequential INT NOT NULL, payment_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, payment_installments INT NOT NULL, payment_value DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (order_id, payment_sequential));



위의 테이블 명세와 사용자의 입력 텍스트를 바탕으로 SQL 쿼리를 작성합니다.
output:
쿼리 작성: SELECT
  t.payment_type,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.distinct_types = 1 THEN t.order_id END) AS mono_order_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT t.order_id) AS type_order_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.distinct_types = 1 THEN t.order_id END) / CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT t.order_id) AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS mono_order_ratio
FROM order_payments t
JOIN (
  SELECT order_id, COUNT(DISTINCT payment_type) AS distinct_types
  FROM order_payments
  GROUP BY order_id
) o ON o.order_id = t.order_id
GROUP BY t.payment_type
ORDER BY mono_order_ratio DESC, t.payment_type;

쿼리 작성: SELECT
  order_id,

  SUM(CASE WHEN payment_installments = 1 THEN payment_value ELSE 0 END) AS one_time_sum
FROM order_payments
GROUP BY order_id
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN payment_installments > 1 THEN payment_value ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN payment_installments = 1 THEN payment_value ELSE 0 END)
ORDER BY installment_sum - one_time_sum DESC, order_id;

쿼리 작성: SELECT order_id
FROM order_payments
GROUP BY order_id
HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN payment_value > 300 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
   AND MAX(CASE WHEN payment_value < 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
ORDER BY order_id;

instruction:
입력 텍스트: 결제 수단별 최소 결제 금액을 기록한 개별 결제 내역의 주문 ID, 결제 수단, 결제 순번, 금액을 목록으로 보여줘

DDL statements:

CREATE TABLE order_payments (order_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, payment_sequential INT NOT NULL, payment_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, payment_installments INT NOT NULL, payment_value DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (order_id, payment_sequential));



위의 테이블 명세와 사용자의 입력 텍스트를 바탕으로 SQL 쿼리를 작성합니다.
output:
쿼리 작성: WITH type_min AS (
  SELECT payment_type, MIN(payment_value) AS min_value
  FROM order_payments
  GROUP BY payment_type
)
SELECT p.order_id, p.payment_type, p.payment_sequential, p.payment_value
FROM order_payments p
JOIN type_min m
  ON p.payment_type = m.payment_type AND p.payment_value = m.min_value
ORDER BY p.payment_type, p.order_id, p.payment_sequential;

쿼리 작성: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_with_single_payment
FROM (
  SELECT order_id
  FROM order_payments
  GROUP BY order_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) = 1
) s;

쿼리 작성: SELECT
  payment_type,
  SUM(CASE WHEN payment_installments >= 12 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt_12_or_more,
  COUNT(*) AS total_cnt,
  SUM(CASE WHEN payment_installments >= 12 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / CAST(COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS ratio_12_or_more
FROM order_payments
GROUP BY payment_type
ORDER BY ratio_12_or_more DESC, payment_type;

쿼리 작성: WITH type_sum AS (
  SELECT order_id, payment_type, SUM(payment_value) AS type_amount
  FROM order_payments
  GROUP BY order_id, payment_type
),
order_tot AS (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS total_amount
  FROM order_payments
  GROUP BY order_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    ts.order_id,
    ts.payment_type,
    ts.type_amount,
    ot.total_amount,
    ts.type_amount / ot.total_amount AS ratio,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY ts.order_id
      ORDER BY ts.type_amount DESC, ts.payment_type ASC
    ) AS rn
  FROM type_sum ts
  JOIN order_tot ot ON ts.order_id = ot.order_id
)
SELECT order_id, payment_type, type_amount, total_amount, ratio
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY ratio DESC, order_id ASC;

instruction:
입력 텍스트: 주문당 결제 건수에 따라 1건, 2건, 3건 이상으로 구분해서 각 구간의 주문 수를 집계해줄 수 있을까?

DDL statements:

CREATE TABLE order_payments (order_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, payment_sequential INT NOT NULL, payment_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, payment_installments INT NOT NULL, payment_value DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (order_id, payment_sequential));



위의 테이블 명세와 사용자의 입력 텍스트를 바탕으로 SQL 쿼리를 작성합니다.
output:
쿼리 작성: WITH order_cnt AS (
  SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM order_payments
  GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN cnt = 1 THEN '1건'
    WHEN cnt = 2 THEN '2건'
    ELSE '3건 이상'
  END AS 결제건수구간,
  COUNT(*) AS 주문수
FROM order_cnt
GROUP BY
  CASE
    WHEN cnt = 1 THEN '1건'
    WHEN cnt = 2 THEN '2건'
    ELSE '3건 이상'
  END
ORDER BY
  CASE
    WHEN MIN(cnt) = 1 THEN 1
    WHEN MIN(cnt) = 2 THEN 2
    ELSE 3
  END;

쿼리 작성: WITH per_order AS (
  SELECT payment_type, order_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM order_payments
  GROUP BY payment_type, order_id
)
SELECT
  payment_type,
  AVG(cnt) AS avg_usage_count_per_order
FROM per_order
GROUP BY payment_type
ORDER BY avg_usage_count_per_order DESC, payment_type ASC;

쿼리 작성: WITH sums AS (
  SELECT payment_type, order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS amount
  FROM order_payments
  GROUP BY payment_type, order_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    payment_type,
    order_id,
    amount,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY payment_type
      ORDER BY amount DESC, order_id ASC
    ) AS rn
  FROM sums
)
SELECT payment_type, order_id, amount
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY payment_type ASC, amount DESC, order_id ASC;

쿼리 작성: SELECT
  order_id,
  MAX(payment_installments) - MIN(payment_installments) AS installment_range
FROM order_payments
GROUP BY order_id
ORDER BY installment_range DESC, order_id ASC
LIMIT 20;

쿼리 작성: WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    payment_sequential,
    payment_type,
    payment_value / NULLIF(payment_installments, 0) AS per_installment_amount
  FROM order_payments
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    payment_sequential,
    payment_type,
    per_installment_amount,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY order_id
      ORDER BY per_installment_amount DESC, payment_sequential ASC
    ) AS rn
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  order_id,
  payment_sequential,
  payment_type,
  per_installment_amount
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY per_installment_amount DESC, order_id ASC;

쿼리 작성: SELECT order_id
FROM order_payments
GROUP BY order_id
HAVING
  SUM(CASE WHEN payment_installments = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
  AND SUM(CASE WHEN payment_installments > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY order_id ASC;

쿼리 작성: WITH mx AS (
  SELECT MAX(payment_sequential) AS max_seq
  FROM order_payments
)
SELECT
  m.max_seq AS max_payment_sequential,
  COUNT(*) AS payments_count
FROM order_payments op
JOIN mx m
  ON op.payment_sequential = m.max_seq;

쿼리 작성: SELECT order_id
FROM order_payments
GROUP BY order_id
HAVING NOT (
  SUM(CASE WHEN payment_sequential = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
  AND COUNT(*) = MAX(payment_sequential)
)
ORDER BY order_id ASC;

쿼리 작성: SELECT
  order_id,
  SUM(payment_value) AS total_amount
FROM order_payments
GROUP BY order_id
ORDER BY total_amount DESC, order_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

쿼리 작성: SELECT
  payment_type,
  payment_installments,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM order_payments
GROUP BY payment_type, payment_installments
ORDER BY payment_type, payment_installments;

쿼리 작성: SELECT
  order_id,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt_13_plus
FROM order_payments
WHERE payment_installments >= 13
GROUP BY order_id
ORDER BY order_id;

쿼리 작성: SELECT
  order_id,
  MIN(payment_installments) AS installments
FROM order_payments
GROUP BY order_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT payment_installments) = 1
ORDER BY installments, order_id;

쿼리 작성: WITH t AS (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    payment_sequential,
    SUM(payment_value) OVER (
      PARTITION BY order_id
      ORDER BY payment_sequential
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS cum_sum
  FROM order_payments
),
u AS (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    payment_sequential,
    cum_sum,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY payment_sequential) AS rn
  FROM t
  WHERE cum_sum > 200
)
SELECT
  order_id,
  payment_sequential,
  cum_sum
FROM u
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY order_id;

쿼리 작성: WITH order_sum AS (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS order_total
  FROM order_payments
  GROUP BY order_id
),
type_sum AS (
  SELECT order_id, payment_type, SUM(payment_value) AS type_total
  FROM order_payments
  GROUP BY order_id, payment_type
)
SELECT
  t.order_id,
  t.payment_type,
  t.type_total,
  t.type_total / o.order_total AS share
FROM type_sum t
JOIN order_sum o ON o.order_id = t.order_id
ORDER BY t.order_id, t.payment_type;

쿼리 작성: WITH per_order AS (
  SELECT order_id, COUNT(DISTINCT payment_type) AS type_cnt
  FROM order_payments
  GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT AVG(type_cnt) AS avg_distinct_payment_types_per_order
FROM per_order;

instruction:
입력 텍스트: 항상 다른 결제 수단과 함께만 사용된 결제 수단은 무엇인가요?

DDL statements:

CREATE TABLE order_payments (order_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, payment_sequential INT NOT NULL, payment_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, payment_installments INT NOT NULL, payment_value DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (order_id, payment_sequential));



위의 테이블 명세와 사용자의 입력 텍스트를 바탕으로 SQL 쿼리를 작성합니다.
output:
쿼리 작성: WITH order_type_count AS (
  SELECT order_id, COUNT(DISTINCT payment_type) AS type_cnt
  FROM order_payments
  GROUP BY order_id
),
order_types AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT order_id, payment_type
  FROM order_payments
),
per_type AS (
  SELECT
    ot.payment_type,
    SUM(CASE WHEN otc.type_cnt = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS solo_orders,
    COUNT(*) AS total_orders_with_type
  FROM order_types ot
  JOIN order_type_count otc ON otc.order_id = ot.order_id
  GROUP BY ot.payment_type
)
SELECT payment_type
FROM per_type
WHERE solo_orders = 0;

쿼리 작성: WITH last_pay AS (
  SELECT p.*
  FROM order_payments p
  JOIN (
    SELECT order_id, MAX(payment_sequential) AS last_seq
    FROM order_payments
    GROUP BY order_id
  ) m
    ON m.order_id = p.order_id
   AND m.last_seq = p.payment_sequential
)
SELECT
  payment_type,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt,
  AVG(payment_value) AS avg_value
FROM last_pay
GROUP BY payment_type
ORDER BY cnt DESC, avg_value DESC;

쿼리 작성: SELECT
  payment_value,
  COUNT(*) AS payment_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count
FROM order_payments
GROUP BY payment_value
ORDER BY payment_value;

쿼리 작성: WITH t AS (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    payment_sequential,
    payment_value,
    LAG(payment_value) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY payment_sequential) AS prev_value
  FROM order_payments
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN prev_value IS NOT NULL AND payment_value <= prev_value THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS violations,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM t
  GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT order_id
FROM agg
WHERE violations = 0 AND cnt >= 2
ORDER BY order_id;

instruction:
입력 텍스트: 할부 횟수가 0인 결제가 포함된 주문의 주문 ID와 그런 결제 건수를 보여주냐?

DDL statements:

CREATE TABLE order_payments (order_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, payment_sequential INT NOT NULL, payment_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, payment_installments INT NOT NULL, payment_value DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (order_id, payment_sequential));



위의 테이블 명세와 사용자의 입력 텍스트를 바탕으로 SQL 쿼리를 작성합니다.
output:
쿼리 작성: SELECT
  order_id,
  COUNT(*) AS zero_installment_count
FROM order_payments
WHERE payment_installments = 0
GROUP BY order_id
ORDER BY zero_installment_count DESC, order_id;

쿼리 작성: SELECT
  SUM(payment_value) AS total_payment_value,
  AVG(payment_value) AS avg_payment_value
FROM order_payments
WHERE payment_type = 'not_defined';

쿼리 작성: WITH max_inst AS (
  SELECT
    payment_type,
    MAX(payment_installments) AS max_installments
  FROM order_payments
  GROUP BY payment_type
)
SELECT
  m.payment_type,
  m.max_installments,
  AVG(p.payment_value) AS avg_payment_value_at_max_installments
FROM max_inst m
JOIN order_payments p
  ON p.payment_type = m.payment_type
 AND p.payment_installments = m.max_installments
GROUP BY m.payment_type, m.max_installments
ORDER BY m.payment_type;

쿼리 작성: SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS even_installment_count,
  SUM(payment_value) AS total_payment_value
FROM order_payments
WHERE payment_installments >= 2
  AND MOD(payment_installments, 2) = 0;

instruction:
입력 텍스트: 결제 순번이 증가할수록 할부 횟수가 항상 감소하는 주문의 주문 ID를 모두 보여줄 수 있나? 결제가 2건 이상인 주문만 포함해 줘.

DDL statements:

CREATE TABLE order_payments (order_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, payment_sequential INT NOT NULL, payment_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, payment_installments INT NOT NULL, payment_value DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (order_id, payment_sequential));



위의 테이블 명세와 사용자의 입력 텍스트를 바탕으로 SQL 쿼리를 작성합니다.
output:
쿼리 작성: WITH seq AS (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    payment_sequential,
    payment_installments,
    LAG(payment_installments) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY payment_sequential) AS prev_installments
  FROM order_payments
)
SELECT
  order_id
FROM seq
GROUP BY order_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
   AND SUM(CASE WHEN prev_installments IS NULL THEN 0
                WHEN payment_installments < prev_installments THEN 0
                ELSE 1 END) = 0
ORDER BY order_id;

쿼리 작성: WITH totals AS (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    SUM(payment_value) AS order_total
  FROM order_payments
  GROUP BY order_id
),
second_pay AS (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    payment_value AS second_payment
  FROM order_payments
  WHERE payment_sequential = 2
)
SELECT
  t.order_id,
  s.second_payment,
  t.order_total
FROM totals t
JOIN second_pay s ON s.order_id = t.order_id
WHERE s.second_payment > t.order_total / 2
ORDER BY s.second_payment / t.order_total DESC, t.order_id;

instruction:
입력 텍스트: 결제 수단별로 평균 결제 순번을 계산해서 오름차순으로 정렬해 줄 수 있냐?

DDL statements:

CREATE TABLE order_payments (order_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, payment_sequential INT NOT NULL, payment_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, payment_installments INT NOT NULL, payment_value DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (order_id, payment_sequential));



위의 테이블 명세와 사용자의 입력 텍스트를 바탕으로 SQL 쿼리를 작성합니다.
output:
쿼리 작성: SELECT
  payment_type,
  AVG(payment_sequential) AS avg_payment_sequential
FROM order_payments

instruction:

DDL statements:

CREATE TABLE order_payments (order_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, payment_sequential INT NOT NULL, payment_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, payment_installments INT NOT NULL, payment_value DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (order_id, payment_sequential));



위의 테이블 명세와 사용자의 입력 텍스트를 바탕으로 SQL 쿼리를 작성합니다.
output:
쿼리 작성: SELECT
  order_id,
  payment_type,
  MIN(payment_sequential) AS first_appearance_sequential
FROM order_payments
GROUP BY order_id, payment_type

쿼리 작성: WITH one_type_orders AS (
  SELECT order_id, MIN(payment_type) AS payment_type
  FROM order_payments
  GROUP BY order_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT payment_type) = 1
)
SELECT payment_type, COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM one_type_orders
GROUP BY payment_type
ORDER BY order_count DESC, payment_type ASC;

쿼리 작성: WITH order_stats AS (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS total_amount, MAX(payment_value) AS max_payment
  FROM order_payments
  GROUP BY order_id
),
first_pay AS (
  SELECT order_id, payment_value
  FROM order_payments
  WHERE payment_sequential = 1
)
SELECT f.order_id, f.payment_value AS first_payment_value, s.total_amount
FROM first_pay f
JOIN order_stats s ON s.order_id = f.order_id
WHERE f.payment_value = s.max_payment
ORDER BY s.total_amount DESC, f.order_id ASC;

쿼리 작성: SELECT

FROM order_payments
GROUP BY payment_type
ORDER BY installment_ratio DESC, installment_count DESC, payment_type ASC;

쿼리 작성: SELECT DISTINCT order_id
FROM (
  SELECT order_id, payment_type, payment_value, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM order_payments
  GROUP BY order_id, payment_type, payment_value
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
) t
ORDER BY order_id;

instruction:

CREATE TABLE order_payments (order_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, payment_sequential INT NOT NULL, payment_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, payment_installments INT NOT NULL, payment_value DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (order_id, payment_sequential));

instruction:
입력 텍스트: 결제 수단별로, 해당 수단으로 결제된 각 주문에서 그 수단의 단일 결제 최대 금액을 구한 뒤 그 최대값들의 평균을 계산해 주실 수 있나요? 평균이 큰 순으로 정렬해 주세요.

DDL statements:

CREATE TABLE order_payments (order_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, payment_sequential INT NOT NULL, payment_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, payment_installments INT NOT NULL, payment_value DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (order_id, payment_sequential));



위의 테이블 명세와 사용자의 입력 텍스트를 바탕으로 SQL 쿼리를 작성합니다.
output:
쿼리 작성: WITH per_order_type_max AS (
  SELECT order_id, payment_type, MAX(payment_value) AS max_value_per_order_type
  FROM order_payments
  GROUP BY order_id, payment_type
)
SELECT payment_type,
       AVG(max_value_per_order_type) AS avg_of_order_max_values
FROM per_order_type_max
GROUP BY payment_type
ORDER BY avg_of_order_max_values DESC, payment_type ASC;

쿼리 작성: SELECT
  order_id,
  COUNT(DISTINCT payment_type) AS distinct_types,
  SUM(payment_value) AS total_amount
FROM order_payments
GROUP BY order_id
ORDER BY distinct_types DESC, total_amount DESC, order_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

쿼리 작성: WITH last_payments AS (
  SELECT op.order_id, op.payment_type
  FROM order_payments op
  JOIN (
    SELECT order_id, MAX(payment_sequential) AS max_seq
    FROM order_payments
    GROUP BY order_id
  ) m ON m.order_id = op.order_id AND op.payment_sequential = m.max_seq
),
all_types AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT payment_type FROM order_payments
)
SELECT a.payment_type
FROM all_types a
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT payment_type FROM last_payments) l
  ON a.payment_type = l.payment_type
WHERE l.payment_type IS NULL
ORDER BY a.payment_type;

쿼리 작성: WITH order_totals AS (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS total_amount
  FROM order_payments
  GROUP BY order_id
),
type_sums AS (
  SELECT order_id, payment_type, SUM(payment_value) AS type_amount
  FROM order_payments
  GROUP BY order_id, payment_type
)
SELECT t.order_id, t.payment_type,
       CAST(t.type_amount AS DECIMAL(18,6)) / o.total_amount AS type_ratio
FROM type_sums t
JOIN order_totals o ON o.order_id = t.order_id
WHERE CAST(t.type_amount AS DECIMAL(18,6)) / o.total_amount > 0.7
ORDER BY type_ratio DESC, t.order_id ASC, t.payment_type ASC;

쿼리 작성: WITH m AS (
  SELECT
    c.customer_state,
    c.customer_unique_id,
    COUNT(*) AS order_cnt
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-02-01'

)
SELECT

  COUNT(*) AS unique_customers,

       AND DATEDIFF(o.order_delivered_customer_date, o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 1
      THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS same_day_approved_next_day_delivered,
  SUM(

      WHEN DATE(o.order_approved_at) = DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp)

쿼리 작성: SELECT
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN oi.on_time = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS on_time_rate_percent,
  SUM(ri.order_revenue) AS total_item_revenue
FROM (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    CASE
      WHEN o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
           AND o.order_delivered_customer_date <= o.order_estimated_delivery_date
      THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END AS on_time
  FROM orders o
  WHERE o.order_estimated_delivery_date >= '2017-12-01'
    AND o.order_estimated_delivery_date < '2018-01-01'
) AS oi
JOIN (
  SELECT
    i.order_id,
    SUM(i.price) AS order_revenue
  FROM order_items i
  GROUP BY i.order_id
) AS ri
ON ri.order_id = oi.order_id;

쿼리 작성: WITH v AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    product_category_name,
    (product_length_cm * product_width_cm * product_height_cm) AS volume_cm3
  FROM products
  WHERE product_length_cm IS NOT NULL
    AND product_width_cm IS NOT NULL
    AND product_height_cm IS NOT NULL
),
m AS (
  SELECT
    product_category_name,
    MAX(volume_cm3) AS max_volume_cm3
  FROM v
  GROUP BY product_category_name
)
SELECT
  v.product_category_name,
  v.product_id,
  v.volume_cm3
FROM v
JOIN m
  ON v.product_category_name = m.product_category_name
 AND v.volume_cm3 = m.max_volume_cm3
ORDER BY v.product_category_name;

FROM products
WHERE product_weight_g IS NOT NULL
  AND product_weight_g < 1000;

CREATE TABLE products (product_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, product_category_name VARCHAR(50) NULL, product_name_lenght INT NULL, product_description_lenght INT NULL, product_photos_qty INT NULL, product_weight_g INT NULL, product_length_cm INT NULL, product_height_cm INT NULL, product_width_cm INT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (product_id));

    WHEN product_weight_g < 500 THEN '0-499g'
    WHEN product_weight_g < 1000 THEN '500-999g'

    ELSE '2000g+'

  AVG(product_photos_qty) AS avg_photos
FROM products

  AND product_weight_g >= 0
  AND product_photos_qty IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY weight_bucket

  WHEN '0-499g' THEN 1
  WHEN '500-999g' THEN 2
  WHEN '1000-1999g' THEN 3
  ELSE 4
END;

DDL statements:

CREATE TABLE sellers (seller_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, seller_zip_code_prefix VARCHAR(5) NOT NULL, seller_city VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, seller_state VARCHAR(2) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (seller_id));



위의 테이블 명세와 사용자의 입력 텍스트를 바탕으로 SQL 쿼리를 작성합니다.
output:
쿼리 작성: SELECT
  seller_city,
  COUNT(*) AS seller_count
FROM sellers
WHERE (LENGTH(seller_city) - LENGTH(REPLACE(seller_city, ' ', ''))) = 1
GROUP BY seller_city
ORDER BY seller_count DESC, seller_city ASC
LIMIT 10;

  COUNT(*) AS prefix_count,
  SUM(seller_cnt) AS total_sellers
FROM (
  SELECT
    seller_zip_code_prefix,
    COUNT(*) AS seller_cnt
  FROM sellers
  GROUP BY seller_zip_code_prefix
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT seller_city) = 1
) t;
